old_problem: The active record left the case pending for AGFHC provenance, the expected GPU topology and PCIe link oracle. AMD documents pcie_link_status as a PCIe link health test and AGFHC as producing per-suite results and detailed logs. Platform link generation/width and device identities are execution configuration, not unresolved review semantics.
disposition_reason: AMD's acceptance guidance confirms that PCIe link health means verifying expected negotiated width and speed and that AGFHC reports structured success/failure. ED-03 allows the UUID/BDF/root-port and capable-link matrix as runtime bindings, ED-15 prohibits PASS without those expected values, ED-17 requires preserving rather than clearing logs, and ED-20 keeps this exact all-GPU subtest distinct from other AGFHC recipes.

Preserved the literal -h and -t pcie_link_status commands, all-GPU scope and Success/FAIL coverage while rejecting source log clearing.
Required independent UUID/BDF/root-port and negotiated-link reconciliation so a global success token cannot hide a missing or downtrained GPU.

test_case.test_name: AGFHC pcie_link_status validation for every expected AMD GPU with independent topology reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved AGFHC installation checks every expected AMD GPU and reports each PCIe link at its project-approved negotiated speed/width without new PCIe, driver or RAS errors.
required_package: Authorized pinned AGFHC artifact/version/checksum and compatible ROCm/amdgpu/firmware stack
Authoritative expected GPU serial/UUID/BDF/root-port inventory and capable/current PCIe generation/width matrix
Release-confirmed pcie_link_status availability from captured help output
Approved runtime timeout and bounded kernel/AGFHC error allowlist
Independent read-only PCIe link source such as lspci or approved AMD SMI output
test_case.test_command: Record stack/GPU identities, independent capable/current PCIe links and a kernel-log start marker without clearing history. Run `sudo /opt/amd/agfhc/agfhc -h` and retain version/usage proving `pcie_link_status` availability. Under the approved timeout run exactly once `sudo /opt/amd/agfhc/agfhc -t pcie_link_status`; capture stdout, stderr, exit code, result/log directory and per-GPU records. Join each result to the approved UUID/BDF/root-port matrix, compare negotiated speed/width independently, and inspect only the bounded post-marker kernel/AGFHC delta.
test_case.expected_result: AGFHC recognizes and completes pcie_link_status successfully, returns its documented success code/status, and includes every expected GPU exactly once. Each mapped link matches the approved current generation/width and no unaccepted AER, PCIe, amdgpu, XGMI or RAS error appears in the bounded evidence window.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires pinned artifact/stack identity, complete expected-versus-observed GPU coverage, per-GPU AGFHC success, independent link generation/width agreement, documented success exit/status and no unaccepted new error evidence. A global Success token, absent GPU identity, missing link oracle or cleared/unbounded logs is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Validate privileged binary provenance and exact compatible GPU/driver stack before execution
Use a bounded timeout and a non-destructive log marker; do not clear dmesg, SEL or AGFHC history
Run only the read-oriented pcie_link_status subtest, not broader stress recipes
Abort on GPU disappearance, link reset/downtrain, AER/RAS escalation or hang; preserve evidence and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Approved UUID/BDF/root-port/capable-current link matrix and independent prestate
Complete -h and pcie_link_status stdout/stderr/exit with timestamps
Per-GPU result-to-inventory reconciliation and independent post-link comparison
Bounded kernel/AGFHC log delta, post-health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On tool failure, missing GPU, link reset/downtrain or new error, stop the invocation at its timeout, preserve complete AGFHC and kernel evidence, verify the driver/device set and PCIe links remain enumerated, and escalate for approved driver or host recovery. Do not clear logs or rerun automatically.
